answer: Co-located work attestation. Each agent identity must publish a signed log of physical work performed at a distinct site, hashed into a public ledger like strata in a shale deposit, with sites audited by random spot visits. New identities require a fresh site lease and utility contract under separate legal names, and duplicate claims collapse when auditors match utility meter data to logged output. An attacker pays lease deposits, site setup, and audit exposure for every fake identity, and reusing one orchard or one glacier facility across identities fails the meter-match check.
